say:1:1821634001:1.text: After Oakly drinks the potion, confusion clouds her eyes. A moment later, it gives way to panic.
say:1:1821634001:1.source_cn: 奥克蕾喝下药水后，眼神一阵迷茫，但很快又变得惊恐。

say:2:1821634002:0.text: D-Dura above... Why am I still in Novaris? Why haven't I made it back to the Lightbearer Empire?!
say:2:1821634002:0.source_cn: 艾……艾雅在上……！我怎么还在诺珐斯，还没有回到耀光帝国？！

say:6:1821634004:1.text: Oh, thank Dura... Seeing you makes me feel so much safer.
say:6:1821634004:1.source_cn: 太好了……看到你真是太让我感到安心了……
say:6:1821634004:1.male: Oh, thank Dura... Seeing you makes me feel so much safer.
say:6:1821634004:1.female: Oh, thank Dura... Seeing you makes me feel so much safer.

say:7:1821634007:1.text: I'm sorry... I lost my composure.
say:7:1821634007:1.source_cn: 抱歉……我刚刚失态了，让你见笑了。
say:7:1821634007:1.male: I'm sorry... I lost my composure.
say:7:1821634007:1.female: I'm sorry... I lost my composure.

say:8:1821634008:1.text: I get claustrophobic... With no sun and no way out of Novaris, I must have panicked after being here so long...
say:8:1821634008:1.source_cn: 其实我只是有些幽闭恐惧症……诺珐斯没有太阳，我待的时间...
say:8:1821634008:1.male: I get claustrophobic... With no sun and no way out of Novaris, I must have panicked after being here so long...
say:8:1821634008:1.female: I get claustrophobic... With no sun and no way out of Novaris, I must have panicked after being here so long...

say:9:1821634009:1.text: At least this room is bright, and I'm not alone... Phew.
say:9:1821634009:1.source_cn: 幸好这里还算明亮，周围也有不少人……呼。
say:9:1821634009:1.male: At least this room is bright, and I'm not alone... Phew.
say:9:1821634009:1.female: At least this room is bright, and I'm not alone... Phew.

say:10:1821634010:1.text: Dura, please watch over me. Let me leave this place soon...
say:10:1821634010:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神啊，请您庇佑我能早点离开这里吧……
say:10:1821634010:1.male: Dura, please watch over me. Let me leave this place soon...
say:10:1821634010:1.female: Dura, please watch over me. Let me leave this place soon...

say:13:1821634006:1.text: You're alive too... so I know you'd tell me the truth.
say:13:1821634006:1.source_cn: 你是生者……应该不会骗我。
say:13:1821634006:1.male: You're alive too... so I know you'd tell me the truth.
